Explanatory Notes:

Revenue: Operational Revenue budgeted for 2021 is K47.1 milllion. A significant component of this revenue is to
be collected from operator license fees, spectrum fees and satellite resources.

The other significant revenue is to be collected from the UAS Project Levy budgeted at K10.0 million.

Total revenue, inclusive of operational revenue, asset disposal, and UAS Projects is K57.1 million.

Expenditure: Operational Expenditure budgeted for 2021 is K41.3 million. This amount is allocated to six functional
departments and the board directors; a total of seven cost centers. The total operational expenditure for 2021 has
decreased by K5.3 million and is attributed to the decrease in staff accommodation costs, due to staff owing their own
homes through the NICTA Home Ownership Scheme, and also the decreases in other corporate overhead costs
budgeted for Economics, Consumer & International Relations, Engineering & Resource Planning, Corporate Services
and Universal Access Secretariat.

Capital expenditure is decrease to K15.8 million from K46.6 million from the previous year. The decrease of K32.8
million is attributed to the reduction in funding from the Rural Communication Projects earmarked for 2021.

Budget Comparison: 2021 versus 2020

The increase of K2.4 million operational revenues in 2021 is attributed to the spectrum fees expected to be collected
from the Digivoip Communications LTD company as a result of its rapid growth and expansion.

There is no surplus anticipated in the budget for 2021. Any surpluses that materialize during the budget
implementation in 2021 will be the result of cost savings or revenue collections exceeding the budget.

Issued this 23rd day of December, 2020.

K.GULO-VUI ,
Chief Executive Officer, NICTA .
